_comment: Per-phase model routing. Follows the skill's own eight-step workflow, collapsing Report and its mandatory STOP into one phase. Reproduce is the only frontier phase, because the skill names it the single likeliest way to reach a confident wrong verdict. See model-registry/references/routing-schema.md.

phases.why: Settles whether this is one repository, a workspace, or a single finding investigation. The mode table maps the request to a mode; nothing is judged about the analyzers yet.
Runs the deterministic inventory sweep for SDK, TFM, LangVersion, analyzer packages, config hierarchy and warning policy. The script produces the facts; this phase records them.

adjust.why: A non-empty UnreadablePaths, UnreadableFiles or ParseErrors collection makes every dependent conclusion undeterminable. Telling that apart from genuinely absent configuration is the difference between a gap in the repository and a gap in the reading, and reporting the second as the first is silent.

phases.why: Assigns every diagnostic to its owning analyzer. A rule prefix is a hint and not proof, and analyzers arrive bundled - a shared CodeStyle package may ship Sonar transitively - so attributing by prefix produces a confident wrong owner and, with it, a wrong remediation.

Discharges both proof obligations: never inherit the caller's named culprit as a premise, and prove the real receiving overload rather than a proxy method. The skill records that this failure arrives wearing evidence - a genuine reproduction of the wrong method - which makes it far more dangerous than hand-waving and the likeliest route to a confident wrong verdict.

Weighs each reproduced rule against the repository's intent and its declared C# version, resolving a genuine conflict by upgrade, configuration, documented exception or code change. Judging technical merit without either chasing novelty or disabling correctness and security rules to reduce noise is the balance here.

Renders findings with facts, inferences and recommendations kept visibly distinct, each carrying rule id, analyzer, version, effective severity, config provenance, evidence and confidence - then stops for the user's resolution. The decisions were made upstream; the discipline is not collapsing recommendation into authorisation.

Emits an agent-neutral, self-contained prompt containing only accepted, accepted-with-constraints or validation-authorised findings. The prompt is executed elsewhere by an agent with no access to this audit, so anything wrongly included becomes an unreviewed policy change in someone's repository.
